metadata.comment: QueryCoreDebitStatus -> the indeterminate debit did NOT execute (Document 05 Scenario C; bd babelstone-t7o3.10). The clearance query asked Core 'was this debit actually executed?' and the answer is no -- no money moved. Higher-priority mapping; fires when the request body contains the marker 'not-executed', driving the saga fail-CLOSED (AWAIT_CORE_CLEARANCE -> DEPOSIT_CONSTITUTION_FAILED) with NO reversal. REVIEW-FLAG C: the 4xx=not-executed encoding is a v1 STUB CONVENTION -- the dispatcher's slot-5 model reads a 422 as a terminal Refused, and the clearance stub reuses that to mean 'debit not found / not executed'. This is NOT the slot-5 'illegal/invalid command' semantics; it is a clearance VERDICT piggybacked on the HTTP status because the v1 ACL has no event channel. DEF-1's real ACL emits a typed DebitNotExecuted event instead.

jsonBody.detail: the queried debit was not executed in Core
